schema.$comment: Open to fields a newer producer adds (SPEC §9). Derived from `records.rs`'s field map by `vocabulary()`; edit the map, not this.

entity_id.description: One entity of this document, by identity. A declared identity is a UUID; a derived one is its root UUID and the generator's key path, which nothing in a converted document produces.
entity_id.title: entity_id

legacy_value.description: A legacy value the dump wrote, kept verbatim in whatever JSON kind it wrote it. It states no type on purpose: the round trip writes back what the dump said, and correcting a kind here would be the converter deciding what the site meant.
legacy_value.title: legacy_value

seat_data.description: Map Creator's `seat_data`, carried as the export states it.

seat_type.description: Map Creator's `seat_type`, carried as the export states it.

station.description: The station Map Creator's `pps_id` names, by entity identity. The export writes the legacy spelling back from the identity, so no display string is load-bearing here (SPEC §2).

station_unresolved.description: Map Creator's `pps_id` verbatim, present only when it names no station of this dump, or is not spelled in the JSON kind the export writes that key back in. Never corrected and never dropped: the round trip writes back what the dump said, and the ledger counts it as a dangling source reference.
